Ford Rehires Engineers After AI Fails to Match Human Expertise

Automaker Ford has rehired approximately 350 human engineers after its reliance on artificial intelligence for vehicle quality checks proved insufficient. The company acknowledged underestimating the value of experienced personnel, with the return of these engineers, referred to as 'gray beards,' reportedly leading to improved quality. This move suggests a re-evaluation of AI's role in complex manufacturing processes.
